title: 12 June 2010: Paul McCartney live at RDS Arena, Dublin
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the RDS Arena in Dublin, Ireland, on 12 June 2010.

It was the eighth concert of the Up And Coming Tour, which lasted for 38 dates between March 2010 and June 2011.

The setlist for the concert was the same as McCartney’s first concert in Mexico City earlier this month, apart from the improvised song ‘Shine A Light In Mexico’.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the RDS Arena on 27 May 2003 during the Back In The World Tour.
